prompts.welcome:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: High-fidelity proposed tutorial confirmation screen for the existing Chinese fantasy game DiceLand.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET / current actual menu screenshot. Preserve its forest ruins, giant die, little board path and three adventurers, viewpoint and wide landscape composition. Replace the existing navy rectangular dialog and cyan buttons only.
Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE only, approved enemy dossier design. Borrow its hand-painted emerald green, antique polished gold bevels, dark walnut title plaque, tiny turquoise jewels and restrained ivy. Do not import its rat, combat HUD, arrows or enemy content.
Create ONE beautiful finished in-game screenshot, landscape ratio approximately 2.17:1 (2640x1216). Preserve the exact original background, softly dimmed outside the modal, visible around all sides. No presentation labels or multi-panel montage.
Redesign the central confirmation modal as a refined compact forest adventurer's guide, approximately 50% of screen width and 56% of screen height. Deep near-opaque forest-green leather with fine brushed grain, warmly highlighted double gold bevel frame, delicately engraved corners and sparse ivy only at upper-left/lower-right. Centered dark carved wood title plaque with two tiny turquoise diamond gems. Strong hierarchy and comfortable spacing, no immense empty dead zone.
Top plaque text exactly: “冒险教程”.
Inside, LEFT third: a small premium hand-painted still life of a cream parchment route map, a single ivory die and a brass compass with soft moss and a few ivy leaves, integrated into the green surface without a rectangular picture border. No characters or new creatures.
RIGHT two thirds: an ivory large headline exactly “即将开始教程，是否开始？”.
Below, legible left-aligned ivory Chinese body, thoughtfully wrapped over 3-4 balanced lines, exact wording: “进入教程会让你了解战斗规则、基本玩法、游戏系统等。教程会从地图推进开始，逐步带你熟悉移动、战斗、资源管理与成长流程。”
Under the paragraph a restrained horizontal row of three small informational gold outline icons with labels, not extra buttons: footprint “地图探索”, die with crossed swords “骰子战斗”, sprout with coin “资源与成长”. These are learning topics, not numbered steps.
Footer with a thin engraved gold divider. Two substantial horizontal buttons aligned side by side with generous separation: PRIMARY on left warm golden parchment, dark legible text exactly “开始教程”, bright bevel and tactile trim; SECONDARY on right subdued dark walnut with thin brass trim, ivory text exactly “返回主菜单”. No cyan or blue flat buttons. Both same height with ample touch area, primary visually dominant. No extra X, skip, purchase, rewards, tutorial duration, step count or other invented actions.
Readable Chinese typography: title tasteful golden calligraphy consistent with reference; body clear substantial print with ivory text and restrained mint emphasis, no ornate calligraphy for dense body copy. All text must be exact and unobscured. Hand-painted premium 2D fantasy UI, tactile high-quality materials, elegant rather than overloaded. Keep every decorative leaf away from text and buttons. This is a visual design proposal, not a technical annotation.
prompts.action:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: Proposed contextual tutorial callout and accurately aligned spotlight on the existing DiceLand map screen.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, actual current “行动点” tutorial screenshot. Preserve the forest scenery, exact existing HUD positions, numbers and layout, character status and lower-right tile card. Completely remove the large central navy modal, cyan button and misaligned large yellow frame.
Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE, newly designed tutorial confirmation. Match its deep forest-green brushed leather, antique beveled gold, dark walnut small title plaque, tiny turquoise accent, sparse ivy and golden parchment primary button. Use the same family in a substantially smaller compact contextual card. No map illustration in this smaller callout.
Output ONE polished in-game screenshot, original wide 2.17:1 composition, not a design board.
The ONLY bright spotlight must closely and precisely follow the actual top-left HUD cell labelled “行动资源” containing “5/5”. This is the first upper-left rectangular cell INSIDE the already existing resource HUD, not the whole screen corner and not the other disaster / difficulty / coin / key cells. Preserve its existing location and size. Place the delicate gold focus outline with only a few pixels of padding around this real cell's outer border; all four corners must visibly line up with the cell. Very restrained soft warm glow and small brass corner caps, no huge thick yellow rectangle, no offset crop, no rectangle over blank forest. Keep this cell undimmed and legible. Subtly dim the rest of the map and UI with a transparent forest-black veil.
Place a COMPACT context card immediately to the right of the top-left HUD block in the open upper-middle forest area, roughly 29% screen width and 28% height, fully on screen and separated from the highlighted cell and other HUD. It must not cover the highlight or the character status. A single fine bent gold leader ending at the highlighted action cell explains the relationship; keep this line restrained.
Card: dark emerald near-opaque body, thin double gold border, tiny engraved ivy in one corner, centered small walnut plaque “地图探索”. Inside, a small footprint icon beside a larger warm ivory / mint title exactly “行动点”.
Body with clear ivory printed Chinese, left aligned in 2-3 well-spaced lines, exact text: “左上角的状态栏显示了你当前的行动点，移动到其它格子都会消耗你的行动点。” Emphasise “行动点” in mint green without repeating foot icons within each phrase.
A thin brass footer divider and one golden parchment button “继续”, aligned right, large enough for touch. No other buttons, no invented numeric progress or total step count, no skip or X. Avoid excessive unused height. Clear relation between callout, spotlight and actual HUD. The small tutorial panel is the focus, other UI remains authentic. Same premium painted DiceLand materials as reference, crisp Chinese, no generic flat UI.
prompts.tile:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: Proposed DiceLand contextual tutorial callout for the actual tile type and coordinate header.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, actual current “坐标与类型” tutorial screenshot. Preserve all forest scenery and exact existing game HUD / lower-right tile detail positions, values and layout. Remove the central large navy tutorial modal, cyan button and badly offset oversized yellow highlight.
Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE, newly designed tutorial confirmation dialog. Match its dark emerald brushed leather, antique beveled brass/gold rails, small walnut label, restrained ivy, tiny turquoise jewel and warm parchment button, in a compact contextual card.
Output ONE finished high-fidelity in-game screenshot, original wide landscape ratio about 2.17:1, not a comparison board.
The ONLY bright rectangular spotlight must hug the actual upper TEXT ROW of the lower-right tile detail panel: the name “战斗” and the coordinate badge “[1,3]”. Enclose those two fields as one clean slim horizontal band, with a few pixels of padding, matching their actual location on the top-right of that panel. The sword picture sits to their left and extends lower; do NOT encompass the whole tall tile card or the status-chip row below. Leave exploration chips, movement cost, enemy attributes and all further lines outside the focus frame. Do not shift or recreate the card elsewhere.
Keep the highlighted name and coordinate fields undimmed and readable. All four corners of the thin gold focus outline must line up with that actual header row. Small precise brass corner accents and a subtle warm halo. Absolutely no rectangle floating over empty forest, no crop outside the screen, no giant thick yellow debug box.
Place the compact tutorial card in the empty forest immediately LEFT of this right-side detail card, around the middle-right of the screen, clear of all HUD and the focused header. Width about 30% screen, height about 27%; comfortably within safe edges. A single fine short gold leader from its right edge ends exactly on the focused header's left edge.
Card has the same polished dark green leather and double gold rails as the tutorial welcome reference, very small ivy corner, small dark walnut top plaque exactly “格子详情”. Larger title exactly “坐标与类型”, with a small compass / location symbol.
Left-aligned ivory Chinese body in about 3 clear lines, exact wording: “第一行包括格子的坐标与类型。“战斗”代表你会在进入该格子时开启一场战斗。” Emphasise “坐标与类型” warm gold, and “战斗” restrained pale coral. Keep all other text readable and unmodified.
Thin footer separator and single warm golden parchment button exactly “继续” aligned right, generous touch height. No extra controls, X, skip, invented step count or feature. Avoid the previous huge empty modal; the compact panel should teach while leaving the targeted UI fully visible. High-quality painted 2D fantasy RPG interface consistent with DiceLand, Chinese characters crisp and correct, no developer annotations or explanatory arrows beyond the one restrained leader.
